knownBugs.label: Passage must always include the brand - 2 passages without Toyota (competitor Tesla matched)
Brand not highlighted when matched entity differs - NOT reproduced (82/82 negative rows have a highlight)

newObservations: Judge matched a competitor as the brand: elpais.com "Coches Tesla" and automobile-propre.com "Voiture électrique : le déclin de l'empire américain" are counted as "Toyota depicted negatively" with matchedEntity "Tesla"; the passage does not mention Toyota and "Tesla" is highlighted (TC-008 step3_then).
Raw markdown in 14 negative passages on 12 sources ([text](url) links, **bold**, ![image](url), trailing \\) - e.g. caranddriver.com 4Runner 2023 (TC-008 step3b).
Article title with a literal backslash: automobile-propre.com "Marché auto : encore un record pour l\'électrique, ..." (TC-008 step3c).
Passages are cut at 140 characters mid-word without an ellipsis (e.g. "... cette marque. A é").
The panel is a modal dialog: a click on another card while a panel is open only closes the panel (does not switch source).
Account interface language is "British English" (en-GB), not en-US as in the TC precondition; English UI strings tested are identical. Setting not changed.
Live data drift during the run (frandroid.com 26/3 -> 27/4 -> 33/5; sources 95 -> 118; zonebourse.com #11 -> #12). Every assertion was evaluated within a single panel load.
API /target-sources/{domain} still returns brief and positive[] (14 positive articles for frandroid.com) while the panel shows neither (behaviour superseded by GEO-1168/GEO-1178).
